# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
adni_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results", "ADNI")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "characteristics_functions.R"))
```

# Define Functions

## Cohort Comparison Tests

```{r func_stats}
get_numeric_signif <- function(data1, data2, column) {
  res <- stats::wilcox.test(
    data1, data2, paired = FALSE, alternative = "two.sided"
  )
  data.frame(
    label = column,
    method = "numeric",
    stat = res$statistic,
    pval = res$p.value
  )
}

get_categoric_signif <- function(data1, data2, column) {
  tab <- table(
    cohort = rep(c("ADNI", "HRS"), c(length(data1), length(data2))),
    category = c(data1, data2)
  )

  res <- stats::fisher.test(tab)

  data.frame(
    label = column,
    method = "categoric",
    stat = res$estimate,
    pval = res$p.value
  )
}

get_signif <- function(
    data1, data2, column, category = c("numeric", "categoric")
) {
  category <- match.arg(category)

  if (category == "numeric") {
    res_df <- get_numeric_signif(data1, data2, column)
  } else {
    res_df <- get_categoric_signif(data1, data2, column)
  }

  res_df
}
```

# Get Table

## Load Phenotypes

```{r load}
adni_data <- readRDS(file.path(adni_dir, "ADNI_2025_MCI_future_data.rds"))

pheno_df <- adni_data$pheno_df
longitudinal_df <- adni_data$longitudinal_df %>%
  dplyr::select("RID", "PHC_Education") %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(longitudinal_df, by = "RID") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    APOE4_carrier = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$APOE4) ~ NA,
      .data$APOE4 == 0 ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "Yes"
    )
  )
```

## Compile Statistics

```{r stats}
characteristic_types <- c(
  baseline_age = "numeric",
  Gender = "categoric",
  APOE4_carrier = "categoric",
  PHC_Education = "numeric",
  raw_pTau = "numeric"
)

res_df <- summarize_characteristics(pheno_df, characteristic_types)

res_df
```

# Run Comparison

## Load HRS Data

```{r load_hrs}
hrs_df <- read_hrs_characteristics(data_dir, longitudinal = TRUE)
```

## Do Statistical Comparisons

```{r comparison}
analysis_df <- data.frame(
  hrs_columns = c(
    "Age",
    "Gender",
    "APOE4_carrier",
    "Education"
  ),
  adni_columns = c(
    "baseline_age",
    "Gender",
    "APOE4_carrier",
    "PHC_Education"
  ),
  categories = c(
    "numeric",
    "categoric",
    "categoric",
    "numeric"
  )
)

res_df <- plyr::ldply(
  .data = 1:nrow(analysis_df),
  .fun = function(index) {
    hrs_column <- analysis_df$hrs_columns[[index]]
    adni_column <- analysis_df$adni_columns[[index]]
    category <- analysis_df$categories[[index]]

    get_signif(
      pheno_df[, adni_column], hrs_df[, hrs_column], hrs_column, category
    )
  }
)

res_df
```
